mechanisms.originalOwner: C retains InsertTask priority ordering, DestroyTask unlink/free and wake selection, xxxSleepTask event scan and send/receive lock rules, UserYield/DirectedYield and CurrentTaskLock. Do not migrate the full original algorithm to F merely because its host services currently live there.
mechanisms.direct: C0117 imports F task-order state and macro callbacks. C0618 also applies here: actual COFF imports wow_user_runtime_current, whose definition belongs to F ntvdm-exe; common header is not implementation ownership. Native heap/event operations already call SDK directly, with retained event-reference primitive already B after P57.
mechanisms.wait: F wait_for_task_or_message handles existing sent messages and MsgWaitForMultipleObjectsEx. It may receive callbacks, synchronize queue projection, increment existing task event counters and signal original task event under runtime lock. It is not a pure native wait leaf that can move wholesale into B. S13 must separate native mechanism from task-state effects without changing original rescan or inventing another queue.
mechanisms.lockAndContext: Original LeaveCrit/EnterCrit delegate to F runtime release/acquire; Enter/ExitWowCritSect invoke client_context to transfer debug/page-domain client view. These callbacks tie exact task lifetime and execution ownership to the same runtime. Header relocation alone does not remove the dependency.
mechanisms.readiness: OPENNT-HOST-123 adds the native-stack eligibility predicate to the C scan. F execution_push/pop owns its nested scopes; native completion marks ready then reacquires through original DirectedYield. Existing persistent_eligibility fixture checks excluded suspended frame, event preservation, locking, idle/hardware paths. This audit classifies the actual contract, not a fresh approval or blanket proof of every nested callback case.
mechanisms.failure: check_death and deliver_apc terminate through existing worker failure owner; APC completion is not modeled as successful task wake. F wait can return unsuccessful status; original loop only branches specially on WAIT_1 and USER_APC. Negative-wait failure propagation must be explicitly tested during S13 before changing that contract; current source alone is not runtime proof.
mechanisms.disposition: No independent native leaf remains to move in place. Keep C algorithms. S13 jointly reconciles runtime lock/current TLS, native wait/message callbacks, readiness and retirement. S14 assesses the original state/declaration ABI. C0117/C0618 remain open; no new exception or source migration.
